svg.title: KV cache reuses the past; compute only the new token
svg.desc: During causal decoding, previous keys and values do not change, so the KV cache stores them and only the new token projections are computed. This removes repeated matrix projections, but attention still reads the cached history and cache memory grows with sequence length.

g.text: KV cache reuses the past; compute only the new token
Past decoder keys and values stay fixed; attention still reads the cached history.
WITH CACHE · APPEND K AND V
attend with qₜ over cached K/V
Queries are used once. Cache memory grows O(n);
attention still reads all cached keys.
